answer: Physical Landmark Custody. An identity must be tied to a real parcel whose coordinates a single operator cannot fake, verified when the agent periodically witnesses a fixed landmark such as a coastal island from that spot. Each check requires a signed, time-stamped reading of that island’s bearing and the soil conditions on the local knoll, so one person cannot occupy many parcels at once. An attacker’s cost is one physical presence and witness device per identity, plus the travel to each canyon site for re-verification.
